definition.def: If you have an image of something or someone, you have a picture or idea of them in your mind.
examples: The image of art theft as a gentleman's crime is outdated. [+ of]
The words 'Cote d'Azur' conjure up images of sunny days in Mediterranean cafes.

definition.def: The image of a person, group, or organization is the way that they appear to other people.
examples: Wellington controlled his image as carefully as any modern politician.
The tobacco industry has been trying to improve its image.

definition.def: An image is a picture of someone or something. [formal]
examples: A computer in the machine creates an image on the screen.

definition.def: An image is a poetic description of something. [formal]
examples: The natural images in the poem are meant to be suggestive of realities beyond themselves.

definition.def: If you are the image of someone else, you look very much like them.
examples: Marianne's son was the image of his father.

definition.def: If you say that one person is the spitting image of another, you mean that they look very similar. [informal]
examples: Nina looks the spitting image of her mother.
